author: Sharon Wren
title: Henry County Sheriff's Office ends Flock partnership - NewsBreak
text:
By Sharon Wren ,
8 hours ago The Henry County Sheriff's Office is ending its partnership with Flock Safety.
A post on the department’s Facebook page said it is ending its partnership with Flock Safety, effective August 31.
(OurQuadCities.com) “Since 2024, the Henry County Sheriff’s Office has operated eight Flock Safety cameras throughout Henry County,” the post said. “The cameras were funded entirely through drug seizure proceeds and not through Henry County taxpayer dollars. During the approximately two years the system has been in operation, there is no indication of any misuse, abuse or improper use of the technology by our personnel.”
The post said the Flock system was a valuable investigative tool that helped deputies in multiple cases. “However, we also recognize the significant public discussion and concerns surrounding automatic license plate reader technology, data privacy and the appropriate balance between public safety and individual privacy.”
“This was not an easy decision,” the post concluded. “We believe the technology provided legitimate investigative value and assisted law enforcement in cases where it otherwise may have been more difficult to identify vehicles connected to criminal activity. At the same time, we believe public trust and confidence in law enforcement are critical.”
